## Trigger Conditions
This error is returned by the contract when:
- `IntentNotPending` validation fails during entrypoint invocation.


---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Check the intent status before calling execute_scheduled; already executed, cancelled, or expired intents cannot be re-executed.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let now = f.env.ledger().timestamp();
let id = schedule_intent(&f, now, now + DAY);
f.client.mock_all_auths().execute_scheduled(&id, &f.recipient);
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_execute_scheduled(&id, &f.recipient));
```
